title: Shared-Prefix KV Reuse Across Standard LoRA Adapters: Quality and Serving Tradeoffs
abstract: arXiv:2609.17109v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A common small-model deployment runs one shared backbone with several LoRA specialists that answer over the same context. Serving them naively re-prefills that shared context once per specialist. We study a narrow, practical question: for already-trained standard LoRA adapters -- not adapters retrained for cache compatibility -- how much task quality is preserved if the backbone's prefill KV cache is computed once and reused across specialists, and what does that buy in serving cost? On a Qwen3-1.7B backbone with two adapters (extractive QA on HotpotQA, arithmetic reasoning on GSM8K), we sweep the boundary at which the specialist takes over from the reused base cache and measure paired quality differences and serving cost. Full-prefix reuse had the lowest prefill cost and a small quality difference on held-out GSM8K (Delta = -4.6 EM at a 160-token budget; -3.0 at 320 tokens; -0.8 under a second training seed -- all favoring native, only

translated_title: 标准LoRA适配器间的共享前缀KV缓存复用：质量与服务成本的权衡
translated_abstract: arXiv:2609.17109v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：一种常见的小模型部署方式是运行一个共享骨干模型，配合多个LoRA专家适配器在相同上下文上进行回答。朴素的推理服务方式会为每个专家适配器重复预填充一次共享上下文。我们研究一个窄而实际的问题：对于已经训练完成的标准LoRA适配器——而非为缓存兼容性重新训练的适配器——如果骨干模型的预填充KV缓存只计算一次并在各专家适配器之间复用，能保留多少任务质量，以及在服务成本上能带来什么收益？在Qwen3-1.7B骨干模型和两个适配器（HotpotQA上的抽取式问答、GSM8K上的算术推理）上，我们扫描了专家适配器从复用的基础缓存接管的边界位置，并测量了成对的质量差异与服务成本。完整前缀复用具有最低的预填充成本，且在留出的GSM8K测试集上质量差异很小（在160词元预算下Δ = -4.6 EM；320词元下为-3.0；在第二个训练种子下为-0.8——所有结果均偏向原生方式，仅……
tldr: 该研究发现，对已训练的标准LoRA适配器复用骨干模型的预填充KV缓存，可在大幅降低服务成本的同时仅带来很小的质量损失。
en_tdlr: Reusing the backbone's prefill KV cache across already-trained standard LoRA adapters substantially reduces serving costs while incurring only minor task quality degradation.
